title: Discovering the Ancient Greeks
description: Foundational approach to the civilization of ancient Greece through the evidence of literature, history and archaeology. Focus on the integration of primary sources to give a narrative of Greek literature and culture. A basic timeline of principal eras and events, and general aspects of material culture from the Bronze Age to the coming of Rome.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GRS 101, GRS 100.
Equivalent of the first term of GRS 100.
